description: Physical corner grasp of a flat cloth; lift 180mm, hold 2s, translate 80mm, lower and release. No pinned particles or attachments.
status: frozen v6 high-clearance release fixed-five protocol
units: m, kg, s; Z up, X towards the worktop, Y to the robot's left

platform_solvers.dexsim: DexUniSolverCfg(contact_mode='full', coupling='two_way'): MuJoCo owns the Franka; VBD owns the triangle cloth and static shapes; per-vertex particle-shape contact
platform_solvers.embodichain: EmbodiChain SimulationManager, NewtonPhysicsCfg(solver='dexuni') with the same DexUni options as the DexSim script
platform_solvers.isaaclab: Newton CouplerProxy: MuJoCo-Warp entry owns the Franka; VBD entry owns the triangle cloth and static shapes; every robot link proxied into VBD; per-vertex particle contact

robot.model_note: Newton-assets FR3 arm + Franka Hand (franka_hand_white); same asset, drives and limits as S01-T
robot.finger_mimic: both finger joints are driven independently with identical targets on all platforms
robot.gravity: robot links do not feel gravity (DexSim gravity compensation 1.0 / IsaacLab disable_gravity)
robot.finger_note: Both fingers start open at q=0.039 m and physically close along world Y around the cloth corner.

solver.parity_note: all coupling/VBD/MuJoCo options carried over explicitly from S01 (see ../PARITY_CHECKLIST.md)

contact.friction_rule: Every shape and the cloth particle set uses mu=1.0; particle-shape friction is averaged on each platform.
contact.contact_model: per-vertex particle-shape contact on all platforms (same as S01)

variants_note: One nominal configuration: 10 substeps with CUDA Graph; five independent processes per platform.

outputs: depth (planar distance to the image plane, m)
images.full: every 30 Hz frame: RGB video + depth/segmentation arrays (state s00 runs)
images.keyframes: RGB/depth/segmentation at phase starts and episode end (perturbed states and variants), to bound data volume

measurement.depth_background: no-hit pixels: DexSim/EmbodiChain return a very large value, Isaac Lab returns 0; raw values are stored, plots mask both
measurement.resolution_note: cameras render at 1280x960 for the HD comparison video; depth, segmentation and RGB keyframes are stored at 640x480 (every 2nd pixel) with the matching intrinsics
measurement.video_policy: Separate media run per platform; build_s03_media.py exports one 2x2 oblique/front comparison at 30 fps.
